content.text:
You were right: the rows in the expanded queue list weren't vertically centered. The "N queued" header row was already fine.

**Cause:** each queued row in `render_queue` (`src/prompt_mode.rs:1426`) was set to align its contents to the top. The cancel button is taller than a line of text, so the number and prompt text sat high in the row. The loading spinner had a small top margin to line it up by hand.

**Fix:** I removed the top alignment so the row goes back to the default, which centers everything. I also dropped the spinner's extra margin, which isn't needed anymore.

It builds, but I haven't looked at it in the running app. One difference you'll see: when a prompt's text wraps to two lines, the number and cancel button now sit halfway down the two lines instead of level with the first one.
